study type: Observational analysis from a randomised trial
exposure: Protein intakes (from fortification and human milk)
cohort: The study included 92 preterm infants born at <31 weeks' gestation with a median gestational age of 28 weeks and a mean birth weight of 1040g.
finding: Infants born weighing <1000g had protein intakes below recommendations, and an increasing number of breastfeeds was moderately and negatively correlated with the rate of weight gain.
birth_weight: Mean 1040g (SD 300g), with infants stratified into <1000g and >=1000g categories.
gest_age: Median 28 weeks (IQR 26-29), all born <31 weeks' gestation.
